'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Mike Richards LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
